paper_title: PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways

claims.statement: PaLM 540B with 8-shot chain-of-thought prompting and an external calculator achieved 58% accuracy on the GSM8K benchmark, outperforming the prior state-of-the-art of 55% from Cobbe et al. (2021).

evidence.quote: Using 8-shot chain-of-thought prompting in combination with an external calculator, PaLM 540B achieves a performance of 58%, which outperforms the prior SOTA of 55% from Cobbe et al. (2021) as shown in Table 10.
